text:
Blanket Deductibles
• The deductible section usually describes a blanket deductible that 
applies in the absence of specific special conditions. This blanket 
deductible is applied to any peril not implicated in special conditions.
• This deductible may be phrased as “USD100,000 any one loss occurrence 
EXCEPT:” or “USD100,000 all other losses” .
• Enter the deductible in BLANDEDAMT in the acc file.
• Monetary blanket deductibles (i.e. not a % deductible) entered in 
BLANDEDAMT are applied to locations covered by a policy.
• NOTE: % blanket deductibles applied in the BLANDEDAMT column of the 
acc file will be based on all location values, not just locations damaged. 
This is rarely used.
